notes.title: Luffi has a release date and it's free!
notes.content: [p]Soon we'll mark the end of a learning journey for myself and the team. Last year, we embarked on a journey to learn new skills and discover a new engine "Unreal". [/p][p][/p][p]Through learning blender modelling, sculpting, texturing, rigging, animating, niagra vfx, shader graph, unreal blueprints, sound design and scored by the ever wonderful Epoch Music crew, this project represents the sum total of our new found abilities![/p][p][/p][p]So I'm really excited to be able to share it with you all and at no cost at all. Please enjoy the simple and sweet story of Luffi finding his way home. It's heartfelt and we think you'll enjoy each last drop of the short adventure![/p]

notes.title: When Demo!?
notes.content:
Welcome fellow panda lovers!

One request we consistently see you ask is: are we going to have a demo? 

And the answer to that is yes! We’re working in earnest to try and get a demo in your hands before next fest in June!

It’ll feature a snippet of the super cozy gameplay and the first three areas for Luffi to experience.

Stay tuned as we have more to show you on that soon!

notes.title: Luffi 2025 Trailer launch!
notes.content:
As Luffi: Homebound inches closer and closer to release, I'm very excited to show off our new trailer for 2025! Inside you'll get a feel for new gameplay elements added and refined. New people, new tasks, new memories!

Check it out on the main store page!

notes.title: Stickers and Reminders!
notes.content:
Luffi's adventures take him through the glade, forest, treetops, cave, village, meadow and mountains. There are often many things to do and people to meet, so a little help goes a long way! To that end Luffi also collects stickers to help mark the important things he's found!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867099/b28d058e646fc49f305ef5eca40f048af660592f.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned for more about Luffi's journey right here!

notes.title: Luffi gets a new look!
notes.content:
Hello and sorry its been a a while! 

In that time however we've been busy overhauling Luffi's look! In time we'll recut the trailer to better reflect the state of the game to go with it.

I'm excited to share with you a quick sneak peak of the art style shift we've been going for!

Until next time chill and enjoy!
